evaluation_population_policy: Run inference on all matched images; calculate DR grade metrics only on successful inference rows with adjudicated_gradable=1 and a valid 0..4 label.

external_grading_scheme.basis: The downloaded label package readme explicitly defines adjudicated_dr_grade as a five-point ICDR grade with these semantics; numeric equivalence was not assumed without this documentation.
external_grading_scheme.name: five-point ICDR

invalid_or_unsupported_metrics.reason: This is an external model evaluation on a released dataset, not prospective clinical validation.
The model outputs DR grades and no DME prediction is being evaluated.
Four label rows have no corresponding image and are explicitly excluded.
